basic_info.description: A rare chance to own a high-performing legacy asset in Telegraph Hill,  one of San Francisco's most coveted neighborhoods. This 9-unit property spans two buildings407-411 Lombard and 10-20 Edgardo Placeoffering a strong annual gross income of $436,706 with low operating expenses. The Lombard building features classic San Francisco charm, while the Edgardo units showcase stylish mid-century flair. Many units offer stunning views, including a standout penthouse boasting panoramic views of iconic landmarks, including the Golden Gate Bridge, Alcatraz, and Coit Tower. Additional highlights include a rooftop deck with panoramic views, 4-car garage spaces, common laundry generating extra income, and separate PG&E metering for each unit.  Steps to the heart of North Beach and North Waterfront restaurants, shops, cafes and parks. Forget stock market volatilityinvest in the timeless appeal and stability of Telegraph Hill.
